note: 2026-10-29: core source/container pins follow main's SHA-256 crypto-hardware option (JUN-578, #1671). The plain x86 emitter inlines vector, pair and string-length access, reads code-relative ASCII bytes for string-code-point-at in line (R4) and caches rax, and the runtime's allocator and string helper paths are flat (seed/70, seed/71, seed/76), so every x86 static image changed. The kotoba-native gate's 192 case-image hash words were updated (source, result, exit and fuel words unchanged), and both gate images were re-emitted. The amu-selfhost gate (seed/CORE-STATIC-MANIFEST, static SIR capacity) still rebuilds seed/MANIFEST to coreContainerSHA256. The controller carries the new pins. The new images need fresh native native24/refusal18/parent-death qualification (selfhost-native CI) before this flag returns to true.
